A module from `06_Module_Building` is a list of co-varying proteins with a colour for a name. This
step says what each module is, three ways: which gene sets its members over-represent, which
members follow it most closely, and whether its members interact with each other more than chance
in STRING, a database of known and predicted protein interactions.

## Packages

clusterProfiler runs the enrichment and STRINGdb the interaction test. tidygraph, ggraph and igraph
draw the networks and are called with `::`.

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(STRINGdb)
library(patchwork)
source(here("00_Setup", "Shared_functions", "analysis_reporting_helpers.R"))
```

## Inputs

The modules and their kME, the tested gene sets, and three STRING v12.0 files kept in
`references/STRING/` (source and version in `references/README.md`).

```{r}
#| label: inputs
stage <- here("01_Processing", "07_Module_Characterisation")
out <- file.path(stage, "c_data")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
string_dir <- "01_Processing/07_Module_Characterisation/references/STRING"
inputs <- c(
  modules = "01_Processing/06_Module_Building/c_data/modules.rds",
  gene_sets = "01_Processing/04_Gene_Sets/c_data/gene_sets.rds",
  string_links = file.path(string_dir, "9606.protein.links.v12.0.min700.txt.gz"),
  string_aliases = file.path(string_dir, "9606.protein.aliases.v12.0.txt.gz"),
  string_info = file.path(string_dir, "9606.protein.info.v12.0.txt.gz")
)
paths <- map_chr(inputs, here)
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
modules <- readRDS(paths[["modules"]])
gs <- readRDS(paths[["gene_sets"]])
members <- filter(modules$membership, module != "grey")
count(members, module, name = "n_proteins") |> arrange(desc(n_proteins))
```

## Gene-set enrichment

Over-representation analysis (ORA) asks, per module and per set, whether more of the module's
genes fall in the set than a random draw of the same size would give. The test is hypergeometric
(clusterProfiler's `enricher()`, run for every module by `compareCluster()`). The universe is the
1,900 measured genes, one per symbol: testing against the whole genome would reward any module for
being muscle. Sets keep the 15-to-500 size rule from `04_Gene_Sets`. Benjamini-Hochberg (BH)
correction runs within each module. No cutoff is applied, so every set is kept with its p.

```{r}
#| label: ora
term2gene <- enframe(gs$sets, "set_id", "gene") |> unnest(gene)
ora_fit <- compareCluster(
  split(members$gene, members$module),
  fun = "enricher", TERM2GENE = term2gene, universe = gs$gene_universe,
  minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1
)
ora <- as_tibble(ora_fit) |>
  transmute(
    module = as.character(Cluster), set_id = ID, gene_ratio = GeneRatio, bg_ratio = BgRatio,
    n_overlap = Count, p = pvalue, fdr = p.adjust
  ) |>
  left_join(select(gs$set_catalog, set_id, collection, pathway), by = "set_id")
ora |>
  slice_min(p, n = 1, by = module, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(module, pathway, gene_ratio, fdr)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-enrichment
#| fig-cap: "Top three sets per module at BH < 0.05. Size: gene ratio. Colour: BH within module."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
ora_fit |>
  clusterProfiler::filter(p.adjust < 0.05) |>
  enrichplot::dotplot(showCategory = 3, label_format = 50, font.size = 7)
```

## Top members

Each module's ten members with the highest kME, the proteins that follow the module most closely.

```{r}
#| label: top-members
top_members <- members |>
  slice_max(kme, n = 10, by = module, with_ties = FALSE)
summarise(top_members, top_members = paste(gene, collapse = ", "), .by = module) |>
  head(4)
```

## STRING interactions

STRINGdb maps the measured proteins to STRING identifiers and counts the high-confidence edges
(combined score at least 700, STRING's "high confidence" band) among each module's members. The
expected count accounts for each member's number of partners in the background, which is the
mapped measured proteins, not the whole proteome. A ratio above 1 means the members interact more
than proteins drawn at random from this experiment. BH runs across modules. At a threshold of 700,
STRINGdb reads the pre-filtered `min700` links file.

```{r}
#| label: string
string_db <- STRINGdb$new(
  version = "12.0", species = 9606, score_threshold = 700L,
  network_type = "full", input_directory = here(string_dir)
)
mapped <- string_db$map(as.data.frame(modules$membership), "uniprot_id", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)
string_db$set_background(mapped$STRING_id)
string_check <- mapped |>
  filter(module != "grey") |>
  summarise(n_mapped = n(), ids = list(STRING_id), .by = module) |>
  mutate(
    enrichment = map(ids, string_db$get_ppi_enrichment),
    n_edges = map_dbl(enrichment, "edges"),
    n_expected = map_dbl(enrichment, "lambda"),
    ratio = n_edges / n_expected,
    p = map_dbl(enrichment, "enrichment"),
    fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH")
  ) |>
  select(-ids, -enrichment)
c(proteins = nrow(modules$membership), mapped = nrow(mapped))
arrange(string_check, desc(ratio))
```

## One label per module

```{r}
#| label: labels
labels <- count(members, module, name = "n_proteins") |>
  left_join(
    ora |>
      slice_min(p, n = 1, by = module, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      select(module, top_set = pathway, top_set_fdr = fdr),
    by = "module"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    ora |>
      filter(collection == "GO_Slim") |>
      slice_min(p, n = 1, by = module, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      select(module, top_go_slim = pathway, go_slim_fdr = fdr),
    by = "module"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    summarise(top_members, top_members = paste(gene, collapse = ", "), .by = module),
    by = "module"
  ) |>
  left_join(select(string_check, module, string_ratio = ratio, string_fdr = fdr), by = "module") |>
  arrange(desc(n_proteins))
select(labels, module, n_proteins, top_set, top_set_fdr, string_ratio)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-string
#| fig-cap: "STRING edges within each module: point observed, tick expected, label the ratio."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
module_colours <- set_names(string_check$module, string_check$module)
string_check |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = rev(labels$module))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = module)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = n_expected, xend = n_edges, yend = module), colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(x = n_expected), shape = 124, size = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = n_edges, fill = module), shape = 21, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = n_edges, label = sprintf("%.1fx", ratio)), hjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "within-module edges (log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

## Networks of the top members

Each module's 25 highest-kME members and the STRING edges among them, at the same 700 threshold.
Node fill is kME; node size is the number of edges among the drawn members. Members with no edge
are left out and counted in the panel title. The layout is force-directed and seeded; its geometry
carries no meaning.

```{r}
#| label: network-edges
network_nodes <- mapped |>
  filter(module != "grey") |>
  slice_max(kme, n = 25, by = module, with_ties = FALSE)
network_edges <- string_db$get_interactions(network_nodes$STRING_id) |>
  distinct(from, to, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  inner_join(select(network_nodes, from = STRING_id, module), by = "from") |>
  inner_join(select(network_nodes, to = STRING_id, to_module = module), by = "to") |>
  filter(module == to_module) |>
  select(module, from, to, combined_score)
count(network_edges, module, name = "edges")
```

`draw_module_network()` takes one module's colour and returns its network panel; it is called once
per module.

```{r}
#| label: fig-networks
#| fig-cap: "STRING edges among each module's top 25 members by kME."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8.5
max_degree <- max(table(c(network_edges$from, network_edges$to)))
draw_module_network <- function(which_module) {
  nodes <- network_nodes |>
    filter(module == which_module) |>
    transmute(name = STRING_id, gene, kme)
  edges <- network_edges |>
    filter(module == which_module) |>
    transmute(from, to, score = combined_score / 1000)
  graph <- nodes |>
    tidygraph::tbl_graph(edges = edges, directed = FALSE, node_key = "name") |>
    tidygraph::activate(nodes) |>
    mutate(degree = tidygraph::centrality_degree()) |>
    filter(degree > 0)
  isolated <- nrow(nodes) - igraph::vcount(graph)
  set.seed(42)
  ggraph::ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
    ggraph::geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = score), colour = "grey70", alpha = 0.6) +
    ggraph::geom_node_point(aes(size = degree, fill = kme), shape = 21, colour = "grey30") +
    ggraph::geom_node_text(aes(label = gene), size = 2.2, repel = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    ggraph::scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 1.2), guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, limits = c(0.4, 1), name = "kME") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), limits = c(1, max_degree), name = "degree") +
    labs(title = sprintf(
      "%s: %d edges among %d members, %d without an edge", which_module, nrow(edges), nrow(nodes),
      isolated
    )) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), legend.position = "right")
}
labels$module |>
  map(draw_module_network) |>
  split(ceiling(seq_along(labels$module) / 4)) |>
  walk(\(panels) print(wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 2, guides = "collect")))
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: validate
stopifnot(
  setequal(labels$module, unique(members$module)),
  all(ora$fdr >= ora$p),
  all(network_edges$combined_score >= 700),
  all(top_members$module %in% labels$module)
)
```

## Summary

`r nrow(labels)` modules were characterised. `r sum(labels$top_set_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)`
have at least one gene set at BH < 0.05, and `r sum(string_check$fdr < 0.05)` have more STRING
edges among their members than expected at BH < 0.05.

## Save

The workbook holds every table above and is the reference for what each module colour means.

```{r}
#| label: save
sheets <- list(
  labels = labels, ora = arrange(ora, module, p), top_members = top_members, string = string_check,
  network_edges = left_join(network_edges,
    select(network_nodes, from = STRING_id, from_gene = gene),
    by = "from"
  ) |>
    left_join(select(network_nodes, to = STRING_id, to_gene = gene), by = "to")
)
holds <- c(
  "One row per module: size, top set, top GO Slim term, top members, STRING enrichment.",
  "clusterProfiler ORA of every module against the 04_Gene_Sets sets, BH within module.",
  "The ten highest-kME members of each module.",
  "STRINGdb PPI enrichment per module: observed and expected edges at score >= 700.",
  "STRING edges among each module's 25 highest-kME members, as drawn."
)
write_workbook(sheets, holds, file.path(out, "module_characterisation.xlsx"), inputs, paths)
```
